data.description: Nestled in the dunes of the Mornington Peninsula, you’ll find a reimagined seaside hideaway, completely unique in its design. Alba’s restaurant Thyme showcases locally-sourced, seasonal produce in the menu created by well-known Melbourne chef, restaurateur, cookbook author and television presenter, Karen Martini. data.description: Peace, tranquillity and pristine, unspoilt beaches are what draw most people to Manyana. You’ll be staying at a private beach house, perched at the top of the street only a short stroll to the seashore of Manyana Beach. This coastal two-story, 4 bedroom, 2 bathroom beach house features wide open spaces and plenty of natural sunlight topped off with luxe coastal furnishings to make you feel right at home. Upstairs consists of a dining area with sweeping coastal views that leads onto a large entertaining deck with both a covered and open area, so you can take in the sun or the shade as you require. On Saturday you set off on your private afternoon wine tour. Immerse yourself in sublime produce and culinary excellence, award-winning wine, rich culture and history, world-renowned scenery and awe-inspiring native wildlife. Add on a private in-house yoga class to keep you relaxed all weekend, or venture south to Bannisters by the Sea in Mollymook to check out their 5-Star eats. The sleepy beachside villages of Manyana and Bendalong share a peninsula surrounded by Conjola National Park that is perfect for a nature stroll. Whether it be taking a drive 30 minutes down the road to Mollymook and Ulladulla, or visiting the historic township of Milton a short 20-minute drive from Manyana, there is plenty of local attractions to see and do on your South Coast getaway.
